about: Any real object without its own category template: the minimum a dossier must hold. Write a category template (kit/knowledge/categories/<name>.json) for a kind of object you will model more than once.
research: 1 the maker's own page or a museum record of the object (primary): its sizes, quoted (kit dossier fact ... --quote)
2 a manual, a catalogue or a drawing: its parts and how they join
3 patents (kit refs patent <number>): design patents draw clean orthographic views
4 pictures of every side players see (CC: kit refs find; a private asset may use others as measure-only)
5 what sets this exact object apart from its look-alikes (kit dossier tell)
6 a reference model if one exists (kit library find)
7 the owner's own photos when the owner has the object: they count as primary
never: content farms (kit/knowledge/sources.json); a number nobody can point to
